text.title: FreshDrop checkout redesign: HEART metrics for Q3 2026
text.h_goal: Buyers find checkout clear and fair
text.h_signal: Score 4+ of 5 in the post-order survey
text.e_goal: Buyers add more items per order
text.e_signal: Use of cart reorder and substitutions
text.a_goal: New buyers complete the first order
text.a_signal: First order within 7 days of install
text.r_goal: Buyers come back for a second week
text.focus: Chosen: Happiness and Task success. Engagement postponed: no baseline data yet
text.decision: Task success target: 92% of orders with no support contact. Checked weekly by Lena
